name: StableTravel

overview.text: StableTravel presents pay-per-request flight research APIs for cash fares, booking links, award availability, tracking, airports and flight history. Listed query prices are $0.02 for flight search, booking-link lookup or award search, $0.01 for tracking or airport information and $0.04 for history. These are data-query costs, not airfare or ticket issuance. Named upstream sources are vendor statements, not verified partnerships or coverage guarantees. Results would still need airline or seller checks for fare freshness, award availability and booking validity before spending money or points.
